title: Query-log and git scenarios share their setup and drop proven duplicates
goal: The single-lookup end-to-end scenarios (TestAnswered, TestFixedSince, TestFetches, TestToolRows, TestRedaction, TestSessions) and the mode scenarios run in a few shared clones split by pipeline stage, the in-git host refusal cases keep one refusal and one non-refusal run with the rest proven by TestHostRules, and test_kb_root, test_kb_mcp, test_kb and test_research_merge build on shared copies or the kb seed; every assertion they made is still made, except the tests the operator agreed to drop.

gates.question: Some e2e tests repeat what a cheaper test already proves: TestCaps (test_querylog.py::test_over_the_caps_entries_wait), TestModesAuto[default] (TestAnswered runs without a config file), the cap and off runs of TestResearch (test_querylog.py research unit tests), and two of the three 'red CI revert files a bug' tests (TestFixes, TestAutonomousWrite, TestAutonomousConverge). None of the first three is tied to an incident in the history. Which may go?
options: drop TestCaps, TestModesAuto[default] and the extra TestResearch runs; keep all three revert tests
drop those and keep only TestAutonomousWrite for the revert bug
drop nothing: only merge setup, keep every test id
gates.recommendation: drop TestCaps, TestModesAuto[default] and the extra TestResearch runs; keep all three revert tests

gates.question: test_research_merge replays task 6b on a --no-hardlinks clone of the whole repository with history. Moving it onto the shared kb seed (no history) is 150-250 worker-seconds cheaper and fixes BG-rrht7uts, but the replay then no longer runs against the real history. Move it?
options: move it onto the seed, keeping its fork commit
gates.recommendation: move it onto the seed, keeping its fork commit

notes: Source: a read-only audit of the test files, their docstrings and git history (2026-09-30), checked against run 1 of the report. Measured under load on the Windows host: the single-lookup scenarios cost 92-199 worker-seconds each (TestRedaction 199, TestAnswered 121, TestToolRows 120, TestSessions 104, TestFixedSince 93, TestFetches 60), TestModesAuto 234 and TestModesOff 155, TestCaps 57, TestResearch 331, TestHostRefusalsInGit 293 plus TestHostNoRefusalInGit 143, test_research_merge 288, test_kb_root 226. Expected saving: 25-30% of tests.py worker time on its own, overlapping ST-4mcoplex. Kept as they are, since each caught a real defect or is the only proof of a property: TestConflict, TestAutonomousConverge, TestPushFailure, TestTwoClones, test_sync.py, TestApply. Merged scenarios are split by pipeline stage so no single loadscope unit grows past the longest one today (about 520 s). _tools/test_ids_dropped.txt lists exactly the ids the operator agreed to drop.
